dataNote: Headlines from public RSS. Map markers are curated illustrative locations of known active theaters and economic/energy nodes — not live event detections. Tension scores are analytical/illustrative only.

changes.title: Iran says US strike killed four at wedding in 'war crime' as US denies targeting civilians

stories.title: Iran says US strike killed four at wedding in 'war crime' as US denies targeting civilians
stories.summary: Iranian media reports two children were among those killed when shrapnel hit a home. Iran then launched missiles and drones at US targets in the Middle East.

stories.title: Iranian attack on Saudi tanker killed two Filipino sailors, Saudi Arabia says
stories.summary: The kingdom condemns the targeting of Sidr, which was reportedly hit by unknown projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday.

stories.title: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
stories.summary: Russia is accused of growing increasingly reckless after Berlin blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport.

stories.title: Rosenberg: Putin's veiled threat to UK part of Russia's campaign against West
stories.summary: The Russian president wants to keep Britain guessing - and stressing - over Moscow's real intentions.

stories.title: Zelensky says airlines should avoid Russian airspace as Ukraine escalates drone operations
stories.summary: Chinese and Gulf state airlines are among those still using Russian airspace. Meanwhile, Russia says it will intensify its own attacks on Ukraine.

stories.title: More than 900 killed in Gaza this year despite ceasefire, Hamas-run health ministry says
stories.summary: The ministry says the total number of people killed in the Strip since 10 October is now more than 1,300, including 301 children.

stories.title: Nepal intensifies relief and recovery efforts after deadly floods, UN says
stories.summary: More than 1,200 people have died and thousands are missing, as rescue efforts continue and aid is airlifted to villages.

stories.title: What we know about reported strike on Iran wedding celebrations
stories.summary: BBC Verify looks at footage showing the aftermath of a strike on a building in southern Iran.

stories.title: New constitution in Guinea-Bissau will undermine democracy, opponents say
stories.summary: Referendum result means fewer seats in parliament and new rules on candidates, ahead of December elections.

stories.title: Trump ally defends Venezuela oil deal amid 'gunpoint diplomacy' criticism
stories.summary: Energy secretary Chris Wright denies US seeks to 'take' country's oil, saying deal is transformation of relations.

stories.title: Mark Carney tells US to 'start being serious' amid escalating trade war
stories.summary: Canadian PM is set to retaliate against tariffs levied by Donald Trump and criticized US officials over insults.

stories.title: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
stories.summary: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China.

stories.title: Almost half of world's farmers poisoned by pesticides every year, experts find
stories.summary: Study reveals that pesticide poisoning kills 11,000 people each year, with India accounting for nearly 60% of fatalities.

stories.title: Japan halves speed limit to 30km/h on all narrow city streets
stories.summary: Speed limit dropped from 60km/h for around 70% of general roads in the hope of making narrow streets of crowded cities safer.
